summary: Iteration 6 — Logo/branding, performance middleware, lazy routes & mobile responsiveness all tested. 16/16 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend branding flow (upload, URL paste, favicon, show-brand-name toggle, remove) works end-to-end. All public, admin and student pages render at 375px with ZERO horizontal overflow. Images have loading=lazy. Server cache MISS/HIT headers present and invalidate on admin writes; gzip active on /api/site. Branding restored to defaults after testing.
verified: POST /api/admin/uploads: admin PNG upload returns /api/uploads/<uuid>.png; file served back correctly; rejects text/plain (400); rejects >2MB (400); student 403; unauth 403
GET /api/admin/site returns header with brand_name, logo_url, favicon_url, show_brand_name
PUT /api/admin/site/layout saves logo & favicon; public /api/site reflects immediately (cache invalidated)
Public cache: X-Cache header present on /api/site, /api/categories, /api/test-series, /api/courses, /api/study-materials, /api/subjects; MISS then HIT; admin write triggers MISS on next GET
gzip Content-Encoding returned when Accept-Encoding: gzip on /api/site

Admin SiteSettings UI: branding-settings section renders; all data-testid elements present (site-brand-name, logo-url, logo-upload, logo-file, logo-preview, logo-remove, favicon-*, show-brand-name-switch, save-site-settings)
After saving external logo+favicon URL with show-brand-name OFF: public navbar shows brand-logo-img, nav-brand-name is hidden, <link rel=icon> href updated
Logo/favicon remove buttons clear value; defaults restored
Mobile 375px: no horizontal overflow on /, /test-series, series detail, /courses, course detail, /study-materials, /leaderboard, /login, /register, /page/terms, /page/privacy

Mobile 375px admin: no overflow on /admin, /admin/questions, /admin/test-series, /admin/tests, /admin/courses, /admin/study-materials, /admin/categories, /admin/users, /admin/orders, /admin/coupons, /admin/site, /admin/home, /admin/pages, /admin/payments; admin-mobile-menu button present
Student mobile 375px: /dashboard, /exam/<attempt> no overflow; 'Open Question Palette' drawer opens correctly
Images on public pages use loading="lazy" (2/2 on /courses, 4/4 on /test-series)
critical_code_review_comments: PublicCacheMiddleware stores unbounded in-memory dict keyed by path+query; fine for small catalog but no size cap could cause memory growth under query-param variation. Low priority.
Upload endpoint reads up to MAX_UPLOAD+1 but FastAPI/Starlette may buffer the full upload in memory first; acceptable for 2MB cap.
seed_data_creation: Uploaded a few 1x1 PNGs via /api/admin/uploads during testing (stored in /app/backend/uploads). Branding settings reverted to defaults.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All logo/branding/perf/mobile-responsive features working. Branding defaults restored (brand=ExamForge, empty logo/favicon, show_brand_name=true). Uploaded test PNGs remain in /app/backend/uploads (unused).
